description:
Unitree’s new “Superman” humanoid just pushed past human sprinting speeds, with the company claiming a top speed of 12.66 m/s (45.6 km/h), slightly above Usain Bolt’s estimated peak speed during his world-record 100m run.

But the record-breaking run didn’t end quite as smoothly. Videos circulating online appear to show the humanoid losing control at high speed and crashing straight into an electrical box.

The robot has only been in development for a little over three months, according to Unitree, so apparently it has already figured out the speed part. Braking might be next.
